picks.title: Scal3R: Learning Efficient Multi-Relative Pose Query for Scalable Online 3D Reconstruction
picks.takeaway: 将在线三维重建重构为多参考相对位姿查询，用轻量token注入冻结主干。
picks.why: ECCV 2026；分离局部几何与全局位姿，解决长视频重建漂移。

picks.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
picks.takeaway: 统一多模态架构联合建模物理、几何与外观三种原生3D世界状态。
picks.why: 引入Omni-Camera统一表征并跨帧传播物理动态，支持生成重建。

picks.title: The Shape of Time: Video-Token Contrast for Temporal Understanding in VideoLMs
picks.takeaway: 面向VideoLM视频token表征的时间反事实对比目标，监督事件动态。
picks.why: EMNLP 2026 main；针对时间理解捷径，直接监督内部视频表征。

picks.title: Sequential Beats Joint: On the Interplay between On-Policy Distillation and RLVR
picks.takeaway: 提出OPD-then-RL两阶段方案以替代OPD与RLVR的联合加权融合。
picks.why: 经验证明两阶段优于纯OPD、纯RLVR及所有联合基线，含机理分析。

picks.title: Why Gated DeltaNet Survives 4-Bit Quantization: NVFP4 W4A4 for the Recurrent Half of a Hybrid 27B LLM
picks.takeaway: 对含48层Gated DeltaNet的混合27B模型实现全线性层NVFP4 W4A4量化。
picks.why: 多任务匹配BF16精度（5任务均值-0.52），实测推翻递归误差累积假设。
